summary_1line: Bhishma defeats and kills the Pandava commander Sweta after a fierce duel despite attempts by other Pandava heroes to intervene.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sweta hurls a blazing golden dart like a meteor toward Bhishma as warriors watch in dread.
Bhishma calmly splits the flaming dart into fragments midair with a volley of arrows.
Bhishma’s Brahma-charged arrow pierces Sweta’s armor and he falls like a collapsing mountain while armies react in shock.
